definitions: The principle that a sum of money is worth more now than the same sum will be at a future date due to its potential earning capacity.
The concept that money available at the present time is worth more than the identical sum in the future due to its potential to earn interest or be invested.
examples: Understanding the time value of money is crucial for making sound investment decisions.
Inflation erodes the time value of money over time.
Financial planners often emphasize the time value of money when discussing retirement savings.
